def truncate_middle(s, maxlen):
    if len(s) <= maxlen:
        return s
    if maxlen <= 3:
        return s[:maxlen]
    remaining = maxlen - 3
    left_len = -(-remaining // 2)
    right_len = remaining - left_len
    left_part = s[:left_len]
    right_part = s[-right_len:] if right_len > 0 else ''
    return left_part + '...' + right_part

def normalize_time_overflow(hh, mm):
    total_minutes = hh * 60 + mm
    day_delta = total_minutes // 1440
    remainder = total_minutes % 1440
    norm_hour = remainder // 60
    norm_minute = remainder % 60
    return (norm_hour, norm_minute, day_delta)
